run_benchmarks_all_configs: run all torax benchmark simulations from test_data configs using multiprocessing with spawn context
run_single_simulation: run a single torax simulation from a CONFIG dictionary and save output as a netCDF file
load_torax_config: load a torax config dictionary and build a ToraxConfig object via model_config.from_dict
write_simulation_output: write a simulation xarray result to a netCDF output file via simulation_app.write_output_to_file
discover_test_configs: discover all .nc config files in test_data directory excluding qualikiz tests
